propositions: Bare-repository fixture setup commands fail under safe.bareRepository=explicit when using implicit discovery (cwd or git -C) instead of explicit --git-dir targeting.
Git config gc.autoDetach false and git symbolic-ref HEAD initialization fail with exit 128 in reclaim/concurrency fixtures when repository discovery is not explicit.
Generic helpers serving both worktrees and bare repositories must not be blanket-converted; worktree calls require -C behavior while only bare-targeted calls require explicit --git-dir.
Test fixtures and production scripts must identify and target bare repositories explicitly without changing host/global Git safety settings or weakening prior corruption defenses.
The infra/scripts/prepare_reclaim_backup.py restore.git path reproduces the same implicit-discovery failure and requires separate explicit targeting alongside fixture repairs.
